# S226 — Role matrix editor, TUI half: edit, add, remove and move rows from the matrix pane

The Roadmap's role matrix pane (`m`) gets five edit keys: change a row, add a row, remove a row, move a row, and edit a rule's text. Each edit asks for its fields one at a time, shows the exact `slicer relay-roles ...` command with `[y/N] (Enter is No)`, runs it on `y`, and shows the reloaded matrix. It uses the `matrix.edit` method of the wire half and changes nothing in the daemon.

## Why

Second half of S173 (owner, 2026-10-31: split S173 into a wire half and a TUI half; agent, vendor and model are free text, with a warning when ork has no adapter for the agent). Depends on `matrix-editor-wire` (S173 after the split): `matrix.edit` with `preview`, its `command` and `warning`, and the `vendor`, `model`, `reasoning` and `note` fields on `roles.matrix` rows. Do not start before that slice has landed.

Owner decisions of 2026-10-29 (S173 note) still hold: TUI only, the five verbs `add`, `set`, `remove`, `move`, `rule-edit`, and edits left uncommitted. The matrix is slicer's; ork shows the command it will run and slicer's own refusals verbatim (`docs/boundaries.md:14`, `lineup.source`).

State of the code at HEAD (2026-10-31): the matrix pane is read-only and has no row cursor. `j`/`k` and `pgup`/`pgdown` scroll it (`internal/tui/roadmap.go:87-100`, routed at `internal/tui/model.go:697-698`), and `docs/dashboard.md:1527-1529` says no other key acts in it. The pane draws a `## ork` section with one line per row, then slicer's text (`matrixLines`, `roadmap.go:153-185`); the result it holds is `itemPane.matrix` (`roadmap.go:20-27`). `n` (new slice) and `N` (note) are refused while the pane is open (`internal/tui/compose.go:47-48`), so those letters are free there. The status area already draws one-off prompts (`internal/tui/view.go:129-157`, the note and new-slice forms) over `textField` (`internal/tui/field.go`). A `Live` test double is extended through an optional interface, as `itemFiler` and `itemNoter` are (`compose.go:163-167`), so `Live` and its fakes stay as they are.

Design (*proposed*; the choices that are the owner's are listed in the manifest):
- Keys while the pane is open and its matrix has loaded: `e` edit a row, `n` add a row, `d` remove a row, `m` move a row, `r` edit a rule's text (the defaults named in the S173 spec). `esc` cancels an edit in progress, then closes the pane as today.
- One prompt at a time, two status lines: `Edit r5 (2/6)  Model, now: opus` over the input. `enter` keeps the value typed (empty means unchanged) and goes to the next field; `shift+tab` goes back; `esc` cancels; paste never submits (`textField`). The first prompt of `e`, `d` and `m` is the row id, checked against the loaded rows before any call ("no row r99"); `r` asks for a rule id from the loaded rules. `e` then asks agent, vendor, model, reasoning and note; `n` asks the role (required), then the same five; `m` asks for the row to place it before (empty means last); `r` asks for the new text (prefilled with the rule's current text). Clearing a field is left to `slicer relay-roles set` (empty means unchanged here).
- After the last field the TUI calls `matrix.edit` with `preview: true`, then shows `Run: <command>` (the daemon's `command`), the `warning` if any in the warning colour (agent with no adapter: "a plan skips this row"), and `[y/N] (Enter is No)`. `y` calls `matrix.edit` again without `preview` and reloads `roles.matrix`; `n`, `enter` and `esc` make no run call. Slicer's refusal (code and message) is shown verbatim in the status and keeps the prompt open for a change.
- The change stays uncommitted in the project (owner, 2026-10-29); the status says so after success: `Edited r5 (uncommitted)`.

## Failing tests

`internal/tui/matrix_edit_test.go`, with a fake like `matrixLive` in `matrix_test.go:20-40` that also implements `MatrixEdit` and records every call:
- `TestMatrixEditKeysOpenOnlyOnALoadedMatrix`: with the pane open and its matrix loaded, `e`, `n`, `d`, `m` and `r` each open a prompt; with the reply still pending, with a failed read, with no daemon, or with a `Live` that lacks `matrixEditor`, they do nothing and the status says why (`No daemon connection; action unavailable`, `Matrix editing unavailable`). Outside the matrix pane the letters keep their meanings (`n` new slice, `N` note). Fails first: the keys do nothing in the pane.
- `TestMatrixEditAsksFieldsOneAtATimeAndSendsOnlyFilledOnes`: `e`, row `r5`, then Enter through agent and vendor, type `opus` for model, Enter through the rest: exactly one preview call with `Op: "set"`, `ID: "r5"`, `Fields: {"model": "opus"}`. A second run types an agent, and both appear. Fails first: no editor.
- `TestMatrixEditRowMustExist`: row `r99` shows `no row r99` and makes no call; the prompt stays.
- `TestMatrixEditAddNeedsARole`: `n` with an empty role shows `Role must not be empty`; with `reviewer` and `Codex` the preview has `Op: "add"`, `Fields: {"role": "reviewer", "agent": "Codex"}`.
- `TestMatrixEditMoveSendsBeforeOrLast`: `m`, `r5`, `r2` sends `Before: "r2"`; an empty answer sends `Last: true`.
- `TestMatrixEditRuleSendsTheText`: `r`, `u3`, the prompt is prefilled with the rule's text; editing it sends `Op: "rule-edit"`, `ID: "u3"`, the new `Text`.
- `TestMatrixEditConfirmShowsTheExactCommandAndNeverRunsOnNoOrEnter`: after the last field the view shows the daemon's `command` text and `[y/N] (Enter is No)`; `n`, `enter` and `esc` leave the fake with the preview call only.
- `TestMatrixEditYRunsOnceAndReloadsTheMatrix`: `y` makes one run call (`Preview` false) with the previewed params, then one `RolesMatrix` read, the pane shows the new matrix at the same scroll offset, and the status reads `Edited r5 (uncommitted)`.
- `TestMatrixEditWarnsOnARowOrkCannotRun`: a preview reply with `Warning` shows it in the warning colour (bold in mono) above the prompt; the edit can still be confirmed.
- `TestMatrixEditShowsSlicersRefusalVerbatim`: a run error with code `unknown_role_row` and its message shows both in the status and keeps the prompt; no reload happens.
- `TestMatrixEditIgnoresAStaleReply`: a reply for an earlier request id (the editor was cancelled) changes nothing, as `TestMatrixPaneShowsAFailureAndIgnoresStaleReplies` does for the pane.
- `TestMatrixEditHintLine`: at 100 columns the hint line offers `e/n/d/m/r edit` beside the existing fields; at 80x24 it drops before `esc close`, `q quit` and `? help`.
- `TestMatrixEditorGoldens`: the prompt (row id, then a field) and the confirm prompt with a warning, at 80x24 and 100x30, colour and mono (`checkGolden`), written to `testdata/golden/matrix-edit-*.txt`.
- Existing tests: `TestMatrixPaneScrollsLikeTheItemPane`, `TestMatrixKeyIsOfferedOnlyOnTheRoadmap`, `TestMatrixPaneGolden` keep passing; the hint-line test is updated for the new field.

## Implement

Tests first; see each fail for the stated reason.

1. `matrix_edit.go`: `type matrixEditor interface { MatrixEdit(context.Context, daemon.MatrixEditParams) (*daemon.MatrixEditResult, error) }` and `var _ matrixEditor = (*Daemon)(nil)`; the state (op, ordered prompts with labels and current values from the loaded rows, typed values, step, request id, previewed params, command, warning); the key handler; the commands that call preview and run in `tea.Cmd`s, never in `Update`.
2. Prompts: build the field list per op as described in Why. Show the current value from the row (`Vendor`, `Model`, `Reasoning`, `Note` from the wire half) as dim text after the label. Validate the row id and rule id against the loaded `Rows` and `Rules` before any call.
3. Routing: the editor takes every key while open (before the pane keys), including `ctrl+c` quit as `composeKey` does. Opening is refused with the statuses in the tests. While a preview or run is pending, only `esc` acts, and its reply is ignored by request id.
4. Drawing: status area only, two lines for a prompt, three or four for the confirm (command, warning, question), clipped to the pane width; no new pane layout. Check 80x24 and 100x30.
5. Reload: after a successful run, re-issue the `roles.matrix` read the way `openMatrix` does and replace the pane's matrix; keep `offset`.
6. Hint line and `?` help as in Files; mark the keys *proposed* in the docs until the owner confirms them.
7. Docs: `docs/dashboard.md` describes the five keys, the one-field-at-a-time prompts, the confirm prompt, the warning, and that the change is left uncommitted.
8. `go test ./internal/tui -update`, then review the new goldens; no existing golden may change except the hint-line ones, if any.
9. `CHANGELOG.md`: one entry under `## Unreleased`, added last.
10. Do not touch `internal/daemon`, `internal/slicercli`, `internal/cli`, or the read-only rendering of the matrix. UI slice: UI pass (r14).
